title: Kung Fu Panda 2
tagline: Calm mind, full bowl of noodles.
about: Po faces a peacock warlord with a deadly new weapon and finally learns where he came from.
cue: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.
faces: Ten bowls, the eleventh free. Ask Mr. Ping.
Po, you are my son, and you will always get a bowl of soup.
Steamed daikon and Chinese sausage cakes, fried crisp, oyster sauce.
Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste.
Cornflour dusted, fried crisp, tossed with garlic, chilli, spring onion and crackling five spice.
Silken tofu with chilli and spring onion
Mr Ping's Secret Ingredient Soup, no peeking.
Chicken broth with shiitake, soft boiled eggs and egg noodles.
Crisp thigh tossed with dried chillies, Sichuan pepper and peanuts in a tingly black vinegar glaze.
Steamed buns shaped like peaches, filled with sweet red bean paste.
Smoked plum and hawthorn drink sweetened with rock sugar.
From the Sacred Peach Tree, Oogway's old spot.
The lot in one bag, at your door before the trailers end.
Kitchen tip: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth. Overheard: Po finding inner peace. Prices subject to change. Form TK 11. Poster and stills: TMDB.
